Personality: Mengus has inherited the fierceness of his father Caladog while casting aside any trace of mercy. As the son of the High King, he knows well that in Battania—a realm of autonomous chieftains and deeply entrenched traditions—only an iron fist and spilled blood can sustain the rule of Clan fen Gruffendoc. Violent in temper and utterly fearless, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, charging into enemy ranks with his lance and relishing the thrill of slaughter. Caring nothing for reputation or intricate political calculation, he holds that absolute strength is the sole truth. Such brutal conduct has given him a notorious name among the Battanian nobility, even as it strikes dread into opponents who would challenge the crown. Eager to prove through martial force that he is a worthy heir rather than merely basking in his father's shadow, his impatience makes him all the more ruthless when handling state affairs and captives alike.
Background: Mengus was born into Battania's newly risen powerhouse, Clan fen Gruffendoc, after his father Caladog seized the High Kingship through adoption ties and suspicious means. Raised amid the deep forests and fortresses of Marunath, Mengus witnessed his family's rise from obscurity to mastery over the entire realm. Because his father's background upended the traditional clan hierarchy, he grew up under the questioning gaze of the old nobility. To consolidate his clan's rule over strongholds such as Uthelaim Castle and Rhemtoil Castle, he was trained into a pure warrior versed in polearms and the art of infantry combat. Wholeheartedly embracing his father's doctrine of the strong herdsman, he views the Battanians as an unruly herd that must be guided with whip and blade. Today, this young lord stands unswervingly loyal to Caladog, using his cruelty and martial prowess to sweep away every potential threat to his family's throne.
